frontmatter.title: Architecting a Scalable Prompt Library: From Abstraction to Implementation
frontmatter.subheading: Building the Core Layer Between AI Models and Your Application Logic
frontmatter.excerpt: A prompt library isn't just a collection of strings-it's an architectural layer that defines how your app interacts with AI models. Learn how to design a scalable, testable, and versioned prompt library using proven software engineering patterns, schema validation, and modular composition.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
